Reference files written by ProPresenter itself, copied from
https://github.com/bussnet/propresenter7-php-lib (MIT, see LICENSE-propresenter7-php-lib):

- `reference-Test.pro` (written by ProPresenter 20, placeholder text only)
- `sample-theme/Theme` (a ProPresenter 18.2 theme; image assets not included)

They are used only as test inputs for reading and template cloning.
